audience: software makers and creators who sell products and subscriptions with Polar

useCases.title: Check revenue and MRR over a period
useCases.text: The AI reads revenue metrics over a date range, by interval: orders, revenue, MRR and active subscriptions. You get a short trend report.

useCases.title: Find cancelled subscriptions and their customers
useCases.text: The AI lists subscriptions by status, active state or cancellation window. You see who cancelled and from which product.

useCases.title: See what a customer has right now
useCases.text: The AI finds a customer by email or text, and reads their state: active subscriptions and granted benefits. You can answer a support question fast.

useCases.title: Review recent orders
useCases.text: The AI lists orders by customer, product, status or date window and opens one with line items, discount and tax.

useCases.title: Refund an order or create a checkout link
useCases.text: The AI refunds an order in full or in part, which moves real money, or creates a reusable checkout link for products.
